originalEvidence.publication: Original PNGs are retained in the contributor's reviewed submission package. This text submission includes their transcriptions and independently checked SHA-256 hashes, not the binary images. Names below are archive names, not repository paths.

calculations.exchangeRateNote: Existing repository comparison constant, not a newly fetched exchange rate.
calculations.monthlyPriceBasis: Actual annual screenshot price divided by ten using the official FAQ; do not use struck-through prices or first-month promotions.

usage.roundingSensitivityNote: Displayed 6pp with consistent endpoint integer rounding implies approximately 5 to 7pp. Not a statistical confidence interval; excludes lag, baseline mismatch and unrelated usage.

normalization.proposal: Explicit temporary exception for maintainer review. Preserve raw estimates until model-specific price ratios are verified; never silently borrow M3 prices. Other normalization rules are unchanged.

proposedAdoption.annualFeeBasis: Upfront annual CNY divided by 12, without rounding cents before unit-price calculation; same tier quota assumed, not independently measured.
proposedAdoption.crossTierBasis: Go baseline multiplied by 3 or 12; assumes advertised ratio applies to the weekly pool.

limitations: Go was explicitly confirmed. A zero hourly counter at the 12:01 starting checkpoint and exclusive shared-pool use were not separately confirmed.
Full-segment arithmetic is conditional on no 12:00-to-start usage. Mid-to-end differences are retained separately; cumulative readings must not be added together.
5h observation is 41% to 100%, not a complete 0% to 100% window; clipping or overshoot at 100% is possible.
Explore struck-through 1490 differs from 119*12=1428. Preserve this conflict; annual/10 determines the proposed monthly price.
Input cache-hit rate and whole-token cache share have different denominators. This workload is not the repository's standard 97/2.5/0.5 mix.
Annual and cross-tier allowances are assumptions, not independent measurements or official fixed token entitlements.
No M3 score or API price is assigned to M3.1. Four weeks/month is a saturated-use comparison convention, not a promise of achievable usage.
